# Live2D web runtime

These browser runtime files are required by the bundled Live2D models:

- `pixi.min.js`: PixiJS 6.5.10
- `cubism4.min.js`: `pixi-live2d-display` 0.4.0
- `live2dcubismcore.min.js`: Live2D Cubism Core v5-compatible runtime

The Pixi and display plugin are MIT-licensed. Cubism Core remains subject to
the Live2D Proprietary Software License Agreement:
<https://www.live2d.com/eula/live2d-proprietary-software-license-agreement_en.html>

Keep this runtime aligned with the hashes recorded in the public Live2D
manifest and do not redistribute the model or runtime outside their license
terms.
